card.name: Just before antigen and antibody terms
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'antigen' or 'anti-' antibody name, such as 'tumor', 'foreign', 'to' after antibodies or response, and the start of anti- words. Seen in immune and autoantibody text.

modes.label: Before 'antigens'
modes.description: A modifier word where 'antigen' is likely to come next.
modes.example: or<< tumor>> antigens for cancer treatment

modes.label: Inside anti- antibody names
modes.description: The start or middle of autoantibody names like anticardiolipin or antineutrophilic.
modes.example: positive for lupus anticoagulant,<< antic>>ardiolipin, and anti-beta

modes.label: 'to' after antibodies or response
modes.description: The word 'to' linking antibodies or a response to a target.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying 'antigen' or 'anti-' next, plus related words like self and presentation.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to name an antigen or an antibody target.
